mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tip_order ( order_no, content_id, amount_cents, contact_name, contact_value, message, status ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, (SELECT id FROM content WHERE code = #{contentCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{amountCents}, #{contactName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contactValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, 'submitted' )
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, amount_cents, status, NULL AS wechat_id, TO_CHAR(received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS received_at FROM tip_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

where.if: AND (t.order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.contact_value ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT t.order_no, c.code AS content_code, t.amount_cents, t.status, t.contact_value, TO_CHAR(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM tip_order t LEFT JOIN content c ON c.id = t.content_id
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.order_no, c.code AS content_code, t.amount_cents, t.contact_name, t.contact_value, t.message, t.status, TO_CHAR(t.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS received_at, TO_CHAR(t.closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS closed_at, TO_CHAR(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM tip_order t LEFT JOIN content c ON c.id = t.content_id WHERE t.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT status FROM tip_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE tip_order SET status = 'received', received_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'submitted'
UPDATE tip_order SET status = 'closed', closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'submitted'
